verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships separate plugins for organizations/multi-tenancy (better-auth-docs-13/26) and for SSO via OIDC/OAuth2/SAML2.0 (better-auth-docs-14), which are the building blocks needed for per-tenant SSO, but the evidence never shows these two plugins combined to give each organization its own SSO connection, nor any mention of domain verification or just-in-time (JIT) provisioning flows. Missing for 10: explicit doc/example wiring SSO connections to specific organizations, domain-verification workflow, and JIT user provisioning on SSO login.
